<script setup lang="ts">
import Dialog from "../dialog/dialog.vue";
import DialogContent from "../dialog/dialog-content.vue";
import Command from "./command.vue";
import { cn, commandDialogContentVariants, commandDialogVariants } from "@/lib/utils";

const props = defineProps<{ open?: boolean; defaultOpen?: boolean }>();
const emit = defineEmits(["update:open", "openChange"]);
</script>

<template>
  <Dialog :open="props.open" :defaultOpen="props.defaultOpen" @update:open="emit('update:open', $event)" @openChange="emit('openChange', $event)">
    <DialogContent :class="cn(commandDialogContentVariants(), 'shadow-lg')">
      <Command :class="commandDialogVariants()">
        <slot />
      </Command>
    </DialogContent>
  </Dialog>
</template>

<view class="command {{extClass}}">
  <input
    class="command-input"
    type="text"
    placeholder="{{placeholder}}"
    value="{{query}}"
    bindinput="onInput"
  />

  <view wx:if="{{filteredItems.length === 0}}" class="command-empty">
    No results.
  </view>

  <view wx:else class="command-list">
    <view
      wx:for="{{filteredItems}}"
      wx:key="value"
      class="command-item {{item.disabled ? 'is-disabled' : ''}}"
      data-value="{{item.value}}"
      bindtap="onSelect"
    >
      <text class="command-item-label">{{item.label}}</text>
      <text class="command-item-value">{{item.value}}</text>
    </view>
  </view>
</view>
